paragraphs: Even the most frightening card here means something other than it seems. Waite read the Tower as the fall of a **“House of Falsehood”**, a building raised on a false foundation. He recalls a line from the Psalms: **“except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it”**. The Tower in Muladhara does not threaten your home. It speaks of the courage not to prop up what rests on a lie.

So instead of asking “how do I open my Muladhara?”, it is more useful to ask: where does the strength of my footing turn into its shadow? In the full reading the third paragraph of every chakra is given over to that turn, and it is written for your combination, not for the arcanum in general.

sections.h2: What this article is based on

ul: **Calculation**: the classic destiny matrix with points A–T. C is the reduced sum of the digits of the year, D = A + B + C. Muladhara = C, D and their sum. All sums above 22 are reduced by adding their digits. The table by year, the number of combinations, the frequencies and the rare arcana were counted by going through every date from 1900 to 2026.

**Card meanings**: A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot (1910, reissued 1922). Quotations are given in Waite’s original English. The theme of Muladhara as foundation and roots comes from Benebell Wen, Holistic Tarot (2015), the chapter on the Seven Chakras Spread.

**Arcana meanings by column, the reading of the triple and the link between strength and trap**: the author’s own interpretation. Neither Waite nor Wen wrote about the destiny matrix or about the physics / energy / emotions columns.
The destiny matrix is an esoteric model for self-reflection with no scientific evidence behind it. It is not a forecast and not advice about money, the body or relationships.

paragraphs: **Find out what keeps you grounded.** Enter your date of birth and you will see the three arcana of your Muladhara and the other six chakras straight away. In the full reading each of the seven chakras is read as a whole: what gives you your footing, what it looks like in life and where strength turns into a trap.

faq.q: Where is Muladhara in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: On the right-hand and bottom corners of the personal square. The right-hand point C (the year arcanum, “Material task”) gives physics, and the bottom point D (“Karmic task”) gives energy. Emotions are their sum. This is the same number that stands in the corner of the family square between them, at point H.

faq.q: How do I calculate Muladhara from my date of birth?
faq.a: Physics is the sum of the digits of your birth year. Energy is day + month + physics. Emotions are physics + energy. Whenever you get more than 22, add the digits. For example, 31.03.1993 gives 22 / 11 / 6.

faq.q: Why does everyone born in the same year have the same first number?
faq.a: Because Muladhara physics is calculated from the year of birth alone. People born in the same year share the first card, but not the whole chakra: energy and emotions depend on the day and month, and a single year produces between 11 and 20 different combinations.

faq.q: Is Muladhara different for men and women?
faq.a: No. Gender plays no part in the calculation: a man and a woman with the same date of birth have the same numbers. The interpretation doesn’t divide people into a “male” and a “female” kind of footing either.

faq.q: Why is it 22 and not 0 in Muladhara? And why is 8 Justice?
faq.a: In the destiny matrix the Fool is numbered 22, because a sum can never be zero. The numbering here is the old Marseille one: 8 is Justice, 11 is Strength. In Waite’s deck and in many tarot books these two cards are swapped. The meaning follows the card’s name, so check interpretations by name, not by number.

faq.q: Why does another calculator show different numbers?
faq.a: Most often, calculators reduce sums above 22 in different ways. Here the digits are added: 29 → 2 + 9 = 11. If you subtract 22 instead, you get 7, and the whole row shifts. Less often, the chakra table itself uses different points. For Muladhara this site uses the classic pair C and D. If the numbers don’t match, check the reduction and the points first, and only then the interpretations.

faq.q: Can Muladhara tell me about money or how my body feels?
faq.a: Only about your way of handling them. Muladhara describes how you deal with money for everyday living, your household and your reserves, what gives you a sense of safety and how you act when life is shaken up. How much money you have and how your body is doing, the numbers do not show.
